content:
Alice (SRE): FYI I published the ACME Dedicated postmortem (VPC peering flap + on-prem route leak). Link in doc store. Short summary: peering failover + stale on-prem route-policy caused cross-tenant traffic.

dino-bot: Postmortem created: /incidents/1859998881-acme-dedicated-postmortem.md :rotating_light:

Ben (Platform): can't open doc right now, paste the action list here?

Alice (SRE): Actions:
1) Harden peering healthcheck + alerting — owner: Ben (Platform) — due: 2026-06-03
2) E2E test for on-prem route-policy detection — owner: Carol (Platform) — due: 2026-06-10
3) Isolation verification script for Dedicated onboarding — owner: Jess (Support) — due: 2026-05-30
4) Customer comms + runbook update — owner: Ryan (Customer Success) — due: 2026-05-28

Carol (Platform): For #2 I need example firewall/gateway snippets from the incident. Alice, can you paste the sample?

Alice (SRE): Pasted sample below:
```
# customer gateway snippet
route-map RM-ALLOW permit 10
 match ip address 101
 set ip next-hop 10.0.0.1
!
# unexpected route we saw
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.0.254
```

Ben (Platform): For #1 we'll add dual-check probes: control-plane state + data-plane TCP handshake across peers. Example: `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=status-code,Values=active` + `nc -vz <peer-ip> 5222`. Plan to open PR today.

Carol (Platform): Agreed. Implementation detail: run probes from Dedicated node netns to avoid false positives. I'll own INF-4822 for e2e harness + onboarding linter.

Jess (Support): I'll build the isolation verification script. Plan: passive mode (ip neigh, ip route show, iptables -L) + optional active tcpdump when customer opts in. ETA 5 days.

Ryan (Customer Success): I'll draft customer comms and a one-page NOC safe-checklist. Sending to legal now (~48h).

Ben (Platform): Also creating INF-4821 to add automated ACL check to onboarding to block stale next-hops. Assigning to me.

Alice (SRE): Recurring pattern note: 3rd peering-related incident in 9 months with asymmetric route installs and slow detection. Proposal: monthly "isolation retro" to surface repeating config classes. Owner: Alice. Start: 2026-06-01.

Carol (Platform): Suggest a lightweight onboarding linter to catch default-originate without next-hop validation.

Jess (Support): Question: many customers won't share on-prem logs. Should scripts be passive-only by default?

Alice (SRE): Yes. Make script dual-mode: passive-only by default, active checks opt-in. Document both modes in runbook.

Ben (Platform): I'll link PRs to the postmortem follow-ups section.

Alice (SRE): I'll run a 2-week follow-up on 2026-06-10 to verify owners/dues and close loop. Please update tracker with PR/issue links.

All: :thumbsup:
